This includes absorbing a $0.20 charge for acquired in-process R&D associated with the upfront payment for the 3SBio transaction. So just to clarify, without the 3SBio deal, we would have raised our Adjusted diluted earnings per share guidance by $0.30.

evidence_quotes.claim: Full-year 2025 revenue guidance was reaffirmed at $61-$64 billion.
evidence_quotes.quote: We continue to expect full-year '25 revenues to be in the range of $61 billion to $64 billion.

evidence_quotes.claim: Adjusted gross margin for Q2 2025 was approximately 76%.
evidence_quotes.quote: Adjusted gross margin for the second quarter was approximately 76%, primarily reflecting the product mix within the quarter.

evidence_quotes.claim: Adjusted operating expenses (SI&A + R&D) declined 8% operationally year-over-year.
evidence_quotes.quote: Total Adjusted operating expenses were $5.8 billion for the second quarter, an 8% decline operationally versus last year.

evidence_quotes.claim: The EPS guidance raise is attributed to strong operational performance, cost management, and a favorable tax rate, not primarily FX or one-time items.
evidence_quotes.quote: Of this amount, approximately two-thirds is due to our strong operational performance and our outlook.

evidence_quotes.claim: Management expresses confidence in the company's outlook.
evidence_quotes.quote: I will describe Pfizer right now as a company with a very strong floor and no ceiling.

evidence_quotes.claim: The guidance partially derisks expected COVID performance in H2 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: I will also point out that while we are raising our Adjusted diluted earnings per share guidance, we are partially derisking the expected COVID performance in the second half of this year.

evidence_quotes.claim: The IRA Medicare Part D redesign had an $825 million unfavorable year-over-year impact in Q2 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: Partially offsetting the increase was an $825 million year-over-year unfavorable impact of higher manufacturer discounts resulting from the IRA Medicare Part D redesign, which took effect in the first quarter of '25, and overall is largely in line with our expectations.

evidence_quotes.claim: The guidance absorbs the impact of currently imposed tariffs and potential price changes from the July 31 letter from President Trump.
evidence_quotes.quote: the company's guidance absorbs the impact of the currently imposed tariffs from China, Canada and Mexico as well as potential price changes this year based on the letter received on July 31 from President Trump.

evidence_quotes.claim: Vyndaqel family grew 21% operationally year-over-year in Q2 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: We delivered another solid quarter for our Vyndaqel family with 21% year-over-year operational growth.

evidence_quotes.claim: Padcev grew 38% operationally year-over-year in Q2 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: Our ADC for the treatment of adult patients with locally advanced metastatic urothelial cancer achieved high year-over-year operational growth of 38% in the quarter

evidence_quotes.claim: Lorbrena grew 48% operationally year-over-year in Q2 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: LORBRENA achieved 48% year-over-year operational growth in the quarter

evidence_quotes.claim: Braftovi/Mektovi grew 23% operationally year-over-year in Q2 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: We saw continued momentum with Braftovi and Mektovi with 23% year-over-year operational growth in the second quarter.

evidence_quotes.claim: Xtandi grew 14% operationally year-over-year in Q2 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: XTANDI contributed strong 14% operational growth during this quarter.

evidence_quotes.claim: Cost improvement initiatives are on track to deliver ~$7.2 billion in net cost savings by end of 2027.
evidence_quotes.quote: we remain on track to deliver on our goal of at least $4.5 billion in cumulative net cost savings from our ongoing cost realignment program by the end of this year. ... in total, we expect approximately $7.7 billion in savings by the end of '27 to drive operating efficiencies

evidence_quotes.claim: Gross leverage target was lowered to 2.7x, and BD capacity is ~$13 billion after the 3SBio deal.
evidence_quotes.quote: Our gross leverage at the end of the second quarter was approximately 2.7 times, which we are now setting as our new target, down from 3.25 times. ... Our business development capacity is now approximately $13 billion following the 3SBio deal.

evidence_quotes.claim: Recently launched and acquired products grew ~15% operationally year-to-date.
evidence_quotes.quote: Year-to-date, Pfizer's recently launched and acquired products delivered $4.7 billion in revenue while growing approximately 15% operationally versus last year.

evidence_quotes.claim: Discussions with the U.S. administration on MFN and tariffs are described as 'extremely productive.'
evidence_quotes.quote: I would say only that these discussions are extremely productive.

evidence_quotes.claim: Generic/biosimilar competition is expected to have an unfavorable revenue impact of approximately $0.5 billion in 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: An anticipated unfavorable revenue impact of approximately $0.5 billion due to recent and expected generic and biosimilar competition for certain products that have recently lost patent or regulatory protection or that are anticipated to lose patent or regulatory protection.

evidence_quotes.claim: Management tone is confident.
evidence_quotes.quote: Our business is performing well, and I'm pleased with the progress we achieved in the second quarter.

evidence_quotes.claim: Revenue was €1,863.8 million, down 1.0% currency-adjusted and down 6.3% reported.
evidence_quotes.quote: In the first quarter, currency-adjusted sales were down by 1.0% to € 1,863.8 million (Q1 2025: € 1,989.8 million). Currencies, especially U.S. Dollar, Turkish Lira and Argentine Peso were a headwind, causing a reported sales decline of 6.3%.

evidence_quotes.claim: EPS from continuing operations was €0.18, up from €0.00 in Q1 2025.
evidence_quotes.quote: Consequently, profit from continuing operations amounted to € 26.5 million (Q1 2025: € 1.1 million) and earnings per share from continuing operations came in at € 0.18 (Q1 2025: € 0.00).

evidence_quotes.claim: Full-year 2026 guidance was confirmed unchanged, with sales decline of low-to-mid single digits and EBIT between -€50m and -€150m.
evidence_quotes.quote: PUMA reiterates its full-year outlook, as originally published on February 26, 2026, supported by a solid performance at the beginning of the year. The anticipated currency-adjusted sales decline in the low- to mid-single-digit percentage range... The company projects an operating result (EBIT) between € -50 million and € -150 million, including one-time effects related to the implemented cost efficiency program.

evidence_quotes.claim: Gross profit margin improved 60 basis points to 47.7%.
evidence_quotes.quote: The gross profit margin increased by 60 basis points to 47.7% (Q1 2025: 47.1%) supported by reversals of inventory reserves, lower freight costs, and a higher DTC share, partially offset by wholesale promotions, product and regional mix effects as well as currency effects.

evidence_quotes.claim: EBIT margin improved to 2.8% from 2.2%.
evidence_quotes.quote: As a result, the EBIT came in at € 51.9 million, up 19.6% from € 43.4 million in the previous year period, resulting in an EBIT margin of 2.8%, (Q1 2025: 2.2%).

evidence_quotes.claim: Q2 2026 sales growth is expected to be clearly below Q1.
evidence_quotes.quote: We expect Q2 to come in clearly below the Q1 result in terms of sales growth.

evidence_quotes.claim: The Middle East conflict and US tariffs are not accounted for in the outlook.
evidence_quotes.quote: The current outlook does not account for potential effects arising from the conflict in the Middle East or the U.S. Supreme Court’s decision regarding U.S. tariffs dated February 20, 2026.

evidence_quotes.claim: EMEA sales declined 10.4% currency-adjusted due to weaker demand.
evidence_quotes.quote: EMEA sales decreased by 10.4% (ca) to € 774.5 million (Q1 2025: € 891.7 million). The decline was driven by a weaker underlying demand in the region, a muted wholesale performance due to the reduction of undesirable business and lower sales in the Middle East amid ongoing conflict in the region.

evidence_quotes.claim: Net debt rose to €1,357.6 million, with deleveraging a top priority.
evidence_quotes.quote: Net debt rose seasonally to € 1,357.6 million at the end of Q1 2026, up from € 994.9 million at the end of Q1 2025... Given the currently elevated level of net debt, deleveraging is a top priority and we target to reduce net debt over the coming years.

evidence_quotes.claim: Inventory clearance is progressing ahead of plan, with normalization expected by end of 2026.
evidence_quotes.quote: We have managed to reduce our inventory levels faster than planned, streamlined our product portfolio and addressed operational inefficiencies... PUMA expects inventories to normalise by end of 2026.

evidence_quotes.claim: DTC business grew 3.8% currency-adjusted, with DTC share increasing to 28.3%.
evidence_quotes.quote: PUMA's Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) business grew by 3.8% (ca), reaching €528.1 million... The DTC share for PUMA increased to 28.3% in Q1 2026, up from 27.5% during the previous year period.

evidence_quotes.claim: Latin America grew 10.5% and Asia/Pacific grew 7.9% currency-adjusted.
evidence_quotes.quote: Latin America saw a growth rate of 10.5% (ca), supported by improving underlying demand, while North American sales rose by 2.3% (ca)... Sales in Asia/Pacific were up by 7.9% (ca) to € 433.8 million (Q1 2025: € 430.5 million), also benefitting from inventory clearance.

evidence_quotes.claim: Strong demand for low profile category, especially Speedcat, across multiple markets.
evidence_quotes.quote: This was further supported by a robust Chinese New Year performance in addition to sustained strong demand for low profile, especially the Speedcat family... We do see significant traction of the business continuously in pretty much all Asian markets, that is Korea, that is Japan, but specifically Southeast Asia... however, also on the other side of the globe, in North America, we do see customers... we do see significant results to the tune that PUMA at this point-in-time with some retailers is the Number Two brand from a sell-out perspective.

evidence_quotes.claim: NITRO platform driving growth in Running and Training, including HYROX.
evidence_quotes.quote: However, both Running and Training saw strong growth, driven by NITRO™ styles and the rapid expansion of HYROX products... The NITRO platform will be relevant across most performance categories in PUMA.

evidence_quotes.claim: 11 teams qualified for FIFA World Cup 2026, driving football apparel sales.
evidence_quotes.quote: Football also demonstrated robust performance, driven by the sale of PUMA jerseys of the eleven football teams - including Portugal - that have qualified for the upcoming FIFA World Cup 2026™ in the USA, Canada, and Mexico.

evidence_quotes.claim: Cost efficiency program delivering OPEX savings, with 450 of 900 additional positions already executed.
evidence_quotes.quote: Operating expenses (OPEX), adjusted for one-time effects, decreased by 5.5% to € 848.5 million from € 897.9 million in Q1 2025, due to positive effects of the cost efficiency programme... 50%, i.e., 450 positions, were already identified, communicated, and executed, i.e., the effective employees have already left the organization latest by the end of Q1.

evidence_quotes.claim: Financial headroom of €1,104.7 million is sufficient for strategic priorities.
evidence_quotes.quote: Cash and cash equivalents, together with unutilised credit lines, provide sufficient financial headroom of € 1,104.7 million to invest in strategic priorities.

evidence_quotes.claim: Management tone is optimistic, describing a solid start and confidence in plans.
evidence_quotes.quote: Operationally, we were off to a solid start to our transition year in 2026... Despite the macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties, we do remain confident on our track to achieve our plans for this year and beyond.

evidence_quotes.claim: The gross margin improvement was partly driven by one-time inventory reserve reversals and lower freight costs, not purely organic.
evidence_quotes.quote: The gross profit margin increased by 60 basis points to 47.7% (Q1 2025: 47.1%) supported by reversals of inventory reserves, lower freight costs, and a higher DTC share, partially offset by wholesale promotions, product and regional mix effects as well as currency effects.

evidence_quotes.claim: Potential input cost inflation from oil prices and freight surcharges due to Middle East crisis.
evidence_quotes.quote: If you look at the market with the oil prices and you know and I think how the mechanisms are in those contracts, there are surcharges. And I think then also what we've seen I think since the start of the Middle East crisis also that there have been bunker and fuel surcharges being raised, so that's actually where we see of course, also then an impact also from the Middle East crisis I think then also to, to come through.

evidence_quotes.claim: Uncertainty on US tariff refunds and potential impact on consumer sentiment.
evidence_quotes.quote: On tariffs, following the Supreme Court ruling, overall U.S. tariffs have come down. That said, visibility on refunds is still limited and the situation may shift quickly again... The greater uncertainty, however, lies in broader consumer sentiment in response to the evolving economic and geopolitical environment globally.
